title: Pokemon TCG Charmeleon Hidden Fates 8/68 Regular Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Enhance your Pokémon TCG collection with this Charmeleon 8/68 card from the Hidden Fates set. This English language, uncommon card features a stunning finish and is perfect for any fan of the game. Use it to strengthen your deck or simply add it to your collection for the love of the game. 

This card is a must-have for any serious collector or player of the Pokémon TCG. Its rarity and unique character make it a valuable addition to any collection. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this Charmeleon card from the Hidden Fates set.
